modules.name: Haptics MAIN
modules.description: Route controller haptics to the grip motor.

modules.name: OpenXR Velocity Frame
modules.description: Correct controller velocity coordinates in supported third-party apps.

modules.name: Controller Whitening
modules.description: Correct covariance whitening and reject invalid camera projections in the controller service.

modules.name: Controller Timestamp Precision
modules.description: Preserve integer request timestamps in the controller HAL.

modules.name: HAL Cache Bypass
modules.description: Recompute controller poses instead of reusing the normal HAL predictor cache.

modules.name: Steam Link Pose Time
modules.description: Forward controller slot timestamps to PCVR. Requires Steam Link 2.0.20 and Velocity Frame.

modules.name: OpenXR QUALITY
modules.description: Experimental QUALITY camera request during visible OpenXR sessions, with thermal and session guards.

modules.name: Galaxy XR OTA Control
modules.description: Block Samsung firmware updates and restore the saved baseline. Changes persistent Android settings; installs disabled.

modules.name: MV-HEVC Eye Fix
modules.description: Correct the left/right eye inversion Samsung Gallery XR shows for MV-HEVC spatial video. Patched libraries are generated on the device from the stock libraries.
